What does the Secretary of State do?

Meet Paul D. Pate, the Iowa Secretary of State

Iowa Secretary of State Paul Pate has dedicated his life to public service. As Iowa's Commissioner of Elections, Secretary Pate is guided by three core principles: service, participation, and integrity. Read more about Secretary Paul D. Pate here!

Programs for Iowans and Iowa businesses

Every Iowan deserves to be Safe at Home

Safe at Home is an address confidentiality program that provides participants with a substitute address.

Human trafficking can affect anyone

Iowa Businesses Against Trafficking (IBAT) empowers businesses to help in the fight to end human trafficking.
